text: Assumption: The absence of standardized error codes in ara::core::Result for GetRateCorrected and GetRateExceeded indicates that errors occur only during severe infrastructure problems — is this correct?

assumption: The absence of standardized error codes in ara::core::Result for GetRateCorrected and GetRateExceeded indicates that errors occur only during severe infrastructure problems.
rationale: [SWS_TS_14226] and [SWS_TS_14229] specify Result<bool>, but do not define error codes.
